hook: Number tokens ride out along a chain of machines and must ride home along the undo chain you build, until squaring or rounding crashes two of them into one output and only a gate can save the day.
outcome: Compose functions, write and verify an inverse by undoing in reverse order, read inverses from a graph as a reflection across y = x, and restrict a domain to make a function one-to-one
sources: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, High School Functions, Building Functions (F-BF.A.1c, F-BF.B.4a to 4d, F-BF.B.5): https://www.thecorestandards.org/Math/Content/HSF/BF/

OpenStax, Precalculus 2e, 1.7 Inverse Functions: one-to-one functions, undoing in reverse order, restricting the domain of x squared, the graph of an inverse reflects across y = x (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/1-7-inverse-functions
OpenStax, Precalculus 2e, 6.3 Logarithmic Functions: log base b undoes b to the x (CC BY 4.0): https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/6-3-logarithmic-functions
